title: refactor(ci): split lint/test/release workflows, optimize cache & parallelism
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: our monolithic CI workflow has grown slow and brittle as we added more repositories and checks. This PR splits the monorepo CI into three focused workflows (lint, test, release), reduces overall matrix cardinality, and improves cache usage and parallelism to reduce queue times and runner costs. Goals: 1) Make lint and test jobs parallelizable and cache-friendly. 2) Reduce redundant matrix rows by moving non-essential combos to conditional jobs. 3) Improve release automation hygiene and add clearer required checks for protected branches. 4) Bump key GH Actions and Node versions for security and performance. Summary of changes: - Add .github/workflows/lint.yml, .github/workflows/test.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml. - Introduce consolidated cache helpers action (internal) to standardize keys and restore/save flows. - Replace large cross-product matrices with targeted matrices + dynamic job expansion for heavy integration tests. - Upgrade actions/checkout to v4, actions/setup-node to v4, and actions/cache to v4. - Move long-running integration tests to scheduled and manual workflows; keep PR validation fast. - Update docs/ci.md and contributing guide to reflect the new workflow split. Checklist: - [x] Split workflows implemented and smoke-tested on feature branches - [x] Cache key scheme reviewed with infra - [x] Matrix reduced and validated against representative repos - [x] Release workflow gated behind a 'release' label and protected branch policy - [x] Docs updated and linked in PR description Notes: initial runs caught a flaky test on the windows runner; a follow-up commit narrows the matrix and pins a flaky test timeout. CI history: first run (2026-02-15) showed test job failure due to a flaky unit test on windows, author applied fix in commit 3 and retriggered; subsequent runs passed. Related: ENG-1421, ENG-1567. This description is a single continuous string containing the motivation, changes, and checklist.

release_notes:
- Split CI into dedicated lint/test/release workflows for faster PR validation and clearer ownership.
- Reduced matrix size and improved caching to cut CI queue times and runner cost.
- Upgraded key GitHub Actions (checkout/setup-node/cache) to supported major versions.
- Moved heavy integration permutations to scheduled workflow to keep PRs fast.
